claims.quote: HexA deficiency leads to impaired degradation and accumulation of GM2 ganglioside, causing progressive neurodegeneration in patients.
HexA deficiency leads to impaired degradation and accumulation of GM2 ganglioside, causing progressive neurodegeneration in patients.
Abnormal GM2 accumulation was revealed in the brains of Hexa-/-Neu3-/- mice using thin-layer chromatography and mass spectrometric analyses.
Treatment with human Neu3 and Istradefylline extended lifespan to 28 weeks, improved body weight, and reduced GM2 accumulation.
Treatment with human Neu3 and Istradefylline extended lifespan to 28 weeks, improved body weight, and reduced GM2 accumulation.

Our results provide the first in vivo evidence that AAV-mediated human Neu3 expression and Istradefylline may slow disease progression, reduce neuropathology, and lessen motor deficits in the Hexa-/-Neu3-/- mouse model of TSD.
